title: Lay %'s ghost
premise: {name} died with a thing undone: {task}. {He} has not gone far.

endings.TRIUMPH: %1 found {name} on the road, walking the same mile over and over, and walked it with {him} to the end. {He} did not look back.
endings.SUCCESS: %1 said aloud what {name} had meant to do, in the place {he} had meant to do it. It was enough. {He} is at rest.
endings.SETBACK: %1 spoke to {name}, and {he} answered. It was not a kind answer.
endings.DISASTER: {name} did not know {he} was dead, and took the news badly. %1 should not have been the ones to bring it.
